name: Chichi no Kokuhaku: Chichi wa Pro no Nikubenki
original_name: 父の告白 父はプロの肉便器
source:
Having accumulated more than enough wealth for his wife and two daughters, and having fulfilled his duties as head of the household, Oki Yusaku is about to reveal his "true occupation," which he has kept hidden for 10 years, in front of the camera, in order to be freed from the titles of husband, father, and breadwinner of the family...

[From [url=https://guffaw-coccyx.booth.pm/items/1549805]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
在为妻子和两个女儿攒下足以衣食无忧的丰厚家产、圆满尽到一家之主的本分之后，为了卸下丈夫、父亲与家庭顶梁柱的重重头衔，冲优作决定在镜头前坦白自己隐瞒了整整10年的“真正职业”……

[摘自[url=https://guffaw-coccyx.booth.pm/items/1549805]BOOTH[/url]]
